messages.subject: CPD: Limitation of liability clauses post-2024 — lunchtime session
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us on 18 November (12:30–13:30, Room 4 / Teams) for a CPD session on drafting and enforcing limitation of liability and indemnity clauses in commercial contracts, including recent case law. Sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour. Register via the intranet.

WC Learning & Development
